Chāgalakṣaṇa
2nd Pariśiṣṭa of Yv. (Katy.). Allahabad 189 (3). America 207. Baroda 12011 (b). Bd. 103. BORI. 103 of 1887-91. Oxf. 386b. Oxf. II. 868 (b). PUL. I. p. 48 (15 verses). RASB. II. 939. Rep. Hpr. 1901-6, p. 2. Weber 251-252. See also list in Caraṇavyūha, TD. 1763.

Chāgaleya
Q. by Rudradeva in Pākayajñaprakāśa, München 78; by Śūlapāṇi in [Page110-a. Vratakālaviveka, RASB. III. 2124. See C.. smṛti below.

Chāgaleya
one of the divisions according to Maitrāyaṇīya recension of Kṛṣṇa Yv. See Caraṇavyūha, TD. 1763.

Chāgaleyasmṛti
Q. by Hemādri, Vijñāneśvara, Oxf. 356a; Mādhavācārya, Oxf. 266b. 270a; by Raghunandana an. Kamalākara, Sam3skārakaustubha, Śrāddhamayūkha an. Prāyaścittamayūkha; also in Mitākṣarā.
Kavindrācārya 634.
See Kane, HDS. I. p. 547a.

Chāgaleyopaniṣad
Yv. Adyar I. p. 26b. Adyar Up. I. p. 181. BORI. 6 of 1919-24.
On its contents see Ind. Stud. IX. p.. 42-46.
